page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance built on the x86_64 architecture under KVM virtualization. It features 4 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, paired with 8.0 GB of total system RAM. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated hardware accelerators such as GPUs, relying on external block storage for operating system and data volumes. Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

The hardware profile prioritizes CPU resource allocation over memory capacity. By providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance minimizes unused memory overhead, offering a cost-efficient profile for CPU-heavy tasks. Because the instance lacks ephemeral local drives, data persistence depends entirely on network-attached storage, making network throughput a critical component of overall system performance.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.xlarge is suitable for compute-intensive workloads that require dedicated processing power with modest memory requirements. Typical deployment scenarios include web application servers, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) worker nodes, lightweight batch execution jobs, and stateless microservices.
